definition: Physical stock in the warehouse that can be allocated to orders
note: Same in both systems once the nightly stock feed has run.

definition: Allocated to orders but not yet picked
note: Still on the ERP book until the pick is confirmed; WMS shows it as allocated not available.

definition: Moving between sites on a transfer or inbound shipment
note: ERP books it at the sending site until WMS confirms the goods receipt; clears at receipt.

definition: Held for a quality check or blocked pending release
note: WMS excludes it from available stock but the interface posts it to ERP as normal stock until the quality release is confirmed.
ERP keeps it in book stock until the write-off journal posts; WMS moves it to damaged straight away.

definition: Expired or obsolete stock awaiting disposal
note: ERP keeps it in book stock until disposal is approved and posted.
